identity.note: Verification design packet only. Does not approve schema/API/Ports, Skeleton, RED execution, or board green.

intent.problem: Prove Claude Code can lead (claim), execute, cancel, surface errors, report, and bind EVID under controlled inputs — with explicit version + selected mode recorded — without assuming every Agent window shares the same UI.
intent.scope: Planning + verification design: BDD draft, TDD case taxonomy, lead/exec/cancel/error/report/EVID matrix, version/runtime fields, dependency gates. Honest NOT RUN for live Claude capability rows until deps and owner approval clear.
out_of_scope: assuming UI parity across Claude Code windows / MCP Apps / embedded panels
forging PASS from docs or Fake MCP
auto-acceptance / product green from provider success

modes.name: Claude Code noninteractive CLI
modes.binding: product launches CLI via approved outbound AgentPort / HOST-EXEC
modes.lead_note: Lead/claim is product-side Assign, not Agent claim

modes.name: Claude Code as inbound MCP client
modes.binding: Agent query/claim/heartbeat/report through inbound MCP driving adapter → same Application ports

modes.name: Agent-window / embedded UI (capability-dependent)
modes.binding: optional projection only; must not be required for tools path

selected_modes_proposed.rule: Each live row must name exactly one selected mode id + Claude Code version + runtime OS/shell. Do not collapse modes into one PASS.

probe_2026_10_26.note: Version probe only; no lead/exec/cancel/report/EVID live exercise; no auth or config mutation.

dependency_blockers.required: Approved local/scripted Agent loop boundary (claim↔run↔report↔EVID) before real Claude substitutes for fixtures
Approved CLI entry / outbound Claude launch argv+cwd+cancel binding
Approved inbound MCP query/claim/report adapter mapping same Application ports
Clear PLANNING_ONLY / NOT_READY_FOR_IMPLEMENTATION + owner-approved module contract and controlled inputs

rows.planned: Claim/query approved work under Guard; reject unauthorized/stale/fingerprint mismatch; single lease winner
Named Claude version + mode runs controlled task; streams/exit classified; no auto-green
Cancel reaches one terminal; lease release only at terminal; late chunks before terminal allowed per HOST contract
Missing path/auth/approval/binding → readable reject, zero start; spawn/runtime failure → Failed terminal, prior evidence unchanged
SubmitRunReport identity/lease/idempotency; duplicate same content stable; conflict rejected
Evidence bind run/task/revision; provider success ≠ FLOW acceptance; HTML/report trace independent of board color

tdd.note: 待辦。有效 RED 須可編譯且因目標行為缺失失敗；獨立驗證與 HTML 追溯；不弱化斷言。

normal: CLI headless controlled fixture then Claude

tdd.red_gate: No READY_FOR_AI_IMPLEMENTATION until skeleton exists, contracts approved, and RED compiles while failing on missing Claude-compat behavior — not docs-only.

acceptance_criteria_proposed: AC-CC-01 Every matrix axis has PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/NOT_RUN with version+mode+runtime fields; never silent omit
AC-CC-02 Live Claude rows use owner-selected mode and recorded version; probe≠verification
AC-CC-03 Unverified Agent UI capability = NOT_RUN / HOST_NOT_VERIFIED; tools path remains independently assertable
AC-CC-04 Dependency blockers listed; BLOCKED not forged as PASS
AC-CC-05 EVID/HTML trace independent; no board self-green
AC-CC-06 TDD taxonomy covers normal/boundary/invalid/dependency/partial/state/transaction/lifecycle/regression before impl
